data.one_liner: Low-code generation for hashCode, ==, toString, copyWith, change, and Builder methods.
data.what_it_does: Generates boilerplate methods like hashCode, ==, toString, copyWith, merge, and Builder classes for Dart classes using a build_runner setup. It uses mixins to remain minimally intrusive on the class interface and supports inheritance, generics, and null values.
use_when: You want to generate boilerplate methods for data classes with low code overhead.
You need support for copyWith, builders, and change classes via mixins.
avoid_when: You do not want to use code generation or build_runner in your project.
strengths: Minimally intrusive on the class interface through generated mixins.
Provides helper classes like *Changes and *Builder for data manipulation.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding mek_data_class and build_runner with mek_data_class_generator to pubspec.yaml, and running build_runner.

alternatives.name: freezed
alternatives.why_pick_it: More feature-rich union types and immutable state modeling using code generation.

alternatives.name: built_value
alternatives.why_pick_it: Strict immutability and deep builder patterns for complex data structures.
